nodes.title: SG-1.2.2 · Create the typed UI store in game/frontend/src/store
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend has zustand declared in package.json but no src/store directory exists. Desired behavior: src/store/uiStore.ts exports a Zustand store holding drawer open state, modal state, sound-enabled and settings flags, with toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings actions, exposed through a typed useUiStore hook. Expected result: components can import useUiStore, and unit tests exercise the real store module. Why: the shell, header and contribution modal need shared UI state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the module src/store/uiStore.ts, when imported, then it exports a typed useUiStore hook
- Given the store, when each of toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings is called, then the matching state changes
- Given the unit tests, when they run, then they import the real store and mock nothing from it


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/store/uiStore.ts
- In scope: Unit tests for the store
- Out of scope: Wiring the store into components
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Preserve: Existing components and tests
- Preserve: zustand dependency in package.json


## Technical constraints
- Zustand ^5.1.0
- TypeScript
- Vitest tests under game/frontend/tests/**/*.test.ts


## Definition of done
- Store and tests are committed together
- Targeted tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · UI store holds drawer and modal state with toggleDrawer, openModal and closeModal
nodes.body:
Context: no UI store exists. Desired behavior: uiStore.ts is a Zustand store with drawerOpen (boolean) and modal (ModalId or null), plus toggleDrawer, openModal(id) and closeModal. Expected result: components can drive the drawer and modal from one store. Why: the mobile drawer and contribution modal need shared state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fresh store, when read, then drawerOpen is false and modal is null
- Given the store, when toggleDrawer is called twice, then drawerOpen goes true then false
- Given the store, when openModal('contribution') is called and then closeModal, then modal is 'contribution' then null


## Scope
- In scope: drawerOpen
- In scope: modal
- In scope: toggleDrawer
- In scope: openModal
- In scope: closeModal
- Out of scope: Sound and settings flags
- Preserve: Existing GameLayout local state until a later wiring task


## Technical constraints
- Use zustand create


## Dependencies
- zustand declared in package.json


## Definition of done
- State and actions exist and are typed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · UI store holds sound and settings flags with toggleSound and toggleSettings
nodes.body:
Context: the header needs sound and settings controls. Desired behavior: the store has soundEnabled (default true) and settingsOpen (default false), with toggleSound and toggleSettings. Expected result: each toggle flips only its own flag. Why: the header sound button and settings control depend on this state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fresh store, when read, then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen is false
- Given the store, when toggleSound is called, then soundEnabled flips and settingsOpen is unchanged
- Given the store, when toggleSettings is called, then settingsOpen flips and soundEnabled is unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: soundEnabled
- In scope: settingsOpen
- In scope: toggleSound
- In scope: toggleSettings
- Out of scope: Audio playback
- Out of scope: Settings panel UI
- Preserve: Drawer and modal state


## Technical constraints
- Same store as REQ1


## Definition of done
- Flags and toggles exist and are typed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A typed useUiStore hook and UiState types are exported for components
nodes.body:
Context: components import state through a hook. Desired behavior: uiStore.ts exports useUiStore (a typed Zustand hook accepting selectors), plus the UiState and ModalId types. Expected result: a component can call useUiStore(s => s.drawerOpen) with type inference. Why: typed, selector-based access avoids unneeded re-renders.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given import { useUiStore } from the store module, when called with a selector s => s.soundEnabled, then it returns a boolean
- Given the module, when its exports are inspected, then useUiStore is a function with getState and setState
- Given tsc --noEmit, when run, then the store compiles without type errors


## Scope
- In scope: Named exports useUiStore, UiState, ModalId
- Out of scope: Component wiring
- Preserve: Existing tsconfig


## Technical constraints
- Named exports only


## Definition of done
- Exports are typed and the type-check passes


## Clarifying questions
- None
